heading: INT. MUNICIPAL PIGEON CENSUS OFFICE - SUBBASEMENT - DAY

units.text: INT. MUNICIPAL PIGEON CENSUS OFFICE - SUBBASEMENT - DAY
A windowless room under City Hall, lit by one fluorescent tube that has been dying since the last administration.
Clipboards hang from nails like pelts.
On every wall, laminated maps of the city are stuck with coloured pins, each pin a flock nobody has visited in years.
GWENDOLYN PRATT, fifties, Regional Avian Statistics Director, stands on a wobbling chair in a cardigan the colour of weak tea.
She holds a single grey feather aloft like a verdict.
Around the long table, the team has gone still.
TOBIAS NKEMELU, thirties, the only person in the office with a tan, lowers his sandwich.
ANJALI VERMA, twenties, sharp-eyed, clicks her pen once, twice.
OSKAR LINDQVIST, sixties, a man built entirely of corduroy, does not look up from his crossword.
MARISOL DUARTE, forties, the department's tired heart, sits with her coat still on.
Colleagues. The Mayor's office wants the Q3 count by four o'clock. We have counted, by my reckoning, eleven pigeons.
units.name: GWENDOLYN

units.text: Eleven in total? In the city?
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Eleven that are confirmed to be pigeons and not, as Oskar's report suggested, "a mood."
units.name: GWENDOLYN

units.text: Seven letters. "Regret, in a hat."
units.name: OSKAR

units.text: Ma'am, I've been telling you since March. The spreadsheet's counting the same bird. Reginald. He's got a limp.
units.name: ANJALI

units.text: Reginald is a limp. Reginald is not a flock.
units.name: GWENDOLYN

units.text: Gwendolyn steps down from the chair.
It rocks, then forgives her.
She smooths the cardigan and, for the first time, looks tired.
Thirty years. Thirty years of pins.
units.name: GWENDOLYN

units.text: An INTERCOM crackles on the wall above the door, a beige box with a tongue of dust.
Hello, subbasement! Leonard from Facilities. Quick heads up, the four o'clock deadline has been moved to "whenever." The Mayor has discovered squirrels.
units.name: LEONARD

units.text: The room exhales as one body.
Tobias resumes his sandwich.
Anjali caps her pen.
Thank you, Leonard.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Also, someone's been leaving feathers in the lift. Just flagging.
units.name: LEONARD

units.text: Gwendolyn looks at the feather in her hand.
She walks to the nearest map and, with great ceremony, pins it to the middle of the city.
Put that down as twelve.
units.name: GWENDOLYN

units.text: It's a feather.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: It's a pigeon in spirit.
units.name: GWENDOLYN

units.text: Oskar fills in a word.
He nods, satisfied, at no one at all.
Hat.
units.name: OSKAR
